import numpy as np
from tslearn.metrics.dtw_variants import lcss_accumulated_matrix_from_dist_matrix

dist_matrix = np.array(tiny_matrix, dtype=float)
sz1, sz2 = dist_matrix.shape
mask = np.ones((sz1, sz2), dtype=bool)
eps = float(np.median(dist_matrix))

acc_cost_mat = lcss_accumulated_matrix_from_dist_matrix(
    dist_matrix=dist_matrix,
    eps=eps,
    mask=mask,
    be="numpy"
)

assert acc_cost_mat.shape == (sz1 + 1, sz2 + 1), f"Expected shape {(sz1 + 1, sz2 + 1)}, got {acc_cost_mat.shape}"
assert acc_cost_mat[0, 0] == 0.0, "Accumulated cost matrix should be padded with zeros at the origin"
assert acc_cost_mat[-1, -1] >= 0.0, "Final LCSS score should be non-negative"
assert acc_cost_mat[-1, -1] <= min(sz1, sz2), "Final LCSS score cannot exceed the length of the shortest sequence"

print(f"__CHECK__ lcss_accumulated_matrix_from_dist_matrix {acc_cost_mat.shape} {acc_cost_mat[-1, -1]}")
